summary.en: A list on the paper side and a tick that hops to one item at a time; the result beside the seam follows: a louvre for the first change, a push after.
summary.zh: 纸面上一个列表，勾选一次跳到一项；接缝旁的结果跟着变：第一次用百叶，之后用推入。

fits: Choosing among modes, presets or targets and seeing each result.
notFor: More than four picks; a list longer than ten.

intent.en: Each choice written on the left makes the result on the right, on the same beat.
intent.zh: 左边写下的每个选择，同一拍上做出右边的结果。

content.en: 2–10 list items (≤ 14 characters, as the product names them), 2–4 picks each with its result, a claim (≤ 5 words).
content.zh: 2–10 个列表项（≤ 14 字符，产品里的原名）、2–4 次挑选各带结果、一句主张（≤ 12 字）。

fits.zh: 在模式、预设或目标之间挑选并看到各自的结果。

notFor.zh: 多于四次挑选；列表长于十项。

en: Use the louvre once; later changes are pushes.
zh: 百叶只用一次，之后用推入。

fits: any film whose input maps line by line to an output

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
